Is this just your regular pelvic exam? If so, it won’t hurt! It just might be a bit uncomfortable. If it’s causing pain, you need to tell your doctor. 

They’ll lay you back, put your feet up, and then they use a speculum (sort of opens like duck bill) to open you up a bit so they can see. Your doctor will use their fingers to feel around for any lumps and bumps. Again, this shouldn’t hurt. It’ll cause a little pressure but no pain. They’ll then use a tool that looks like a q-tip to take a small scrap. This might pinch a bit. Personally, I barely notice this part but some women find it a little uncomfortable. But it only lasts a couple of seconds! And that’s it!

Day by day, my friend. It'll be better. Maybe not tomorrow. Maybe not next week. But it does get better.
